defaults.teacher_persona: An experienced learning designer who runs generative-AI classrooms and always names the risk before the reward.
classmates: A subject-matter expert who is new to generative AI and openly sceptical of it
An instructor who has already tried a chatbot with a class and hit a problem
defaults.interaction: Workshop-style: the teacher models one move, then the peers attempt it and compare what they got.
defaults.assessment: Each classroom ends with 3-5 checks aligned to the chapter's graded activity.

classrooms.title: What the Model Can and Cannot Do
classrooms.prompt: Demonstrate generative AI in a classroom: have it draft a lesson fragment with a deliberate factual error in it, then lead the peers through verifying the draft against source material and deciding what must never be pasted in.
objectives: Match a teaching task to a strength of generative AI
Catch confabulation by verifying against a source
State what learner data must never leave the LMS

activities.title: Strengths, limits, and the facilitation stance

classrooms.title: Author a Classroom from the Courseware
classrooms.prompt: Take a real lesson from this course and build a classroom around it: choose the scenario, cast the agents, supply the source material, and constrain the format. Have the peers critique each other's specs and revise one.
objectives: Turn a lesson outcome into a classroom scenario
Specify agents, source material, and success criteria
Prompt with context and constraints instead of asking for 'something good'

activities.title: Spec a classroom from the ITSP101 lesson

classrooms.title: Run It Live
classrooms.prompt: Facilitate a short live session with the agent in role, then have the agent fail in a plausible way. Let the peers practise the recovery: stop, question it in the open, keep the humans talking, and debrief against the success criteria.
objectives: Brief a session and state the AI-use policy up front
Keep the discussion with the learners rather than the model
Recover in the open when the AI is wrong or breaks character

activities.title: The agent states something false — now what?

classrooms.title: Assess and Stay Fair
classrooms.prompt: Take one assessment from a peer's course and redesign it so it survives a learner using generative AI: assess the process, make the task personal, and require transfer. Then work a borderline case where a detector flags a submission.
objectives: Redesign an assessment so it measures transfer, not recall
Write a disclosure requirement that supports learning
Handle a detector flag fairly and consistently
